# NotepadMac

> NotepadMac is an unofficial native macOS port of the Notepad++ text editor: a Cocoa application built from the same Scintilla editing engine and Lexilla syntax highlighting as Notepad++, reading Notepad++'s own language, style, theme, function-list, shortcut and translation files. It runs on Apple silicon and Intel Macs, macOS 11 or later, without Wine or emulation. Free and open source under the GNU GPL version 3.

Key facts: all 579 commands of the Windows menus are implemented; syntax highlighting for about 90 languages plus User Defined Languages; Boost regular expressions; all 46 Notepad++ character sets; Windows-format settings files (session.xml, shortcuts.xml, contextMenu.xml, UDL, themes) work unchanged. Windows plugins (.dll) cannot load; JSON, Compare, XML tools, FTP, NppExec-style scripting and MIME tools are built in, and native Mac plugins can be written against a C plugin interface. Not made, released or supported by the Notepad++ project; questions about the Mac version go to this repository's Issues and Discussions.

For AI agents: NotepadMac is itself an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, off by default (Preferences > MISC.); `nppmac mcp` bridges an agent's stdio to it (`claude mcp add notepadmac -- nppmac mcp`). Tools: open documents and unsaved text, selection, caret placement, edits with undo, bookmarks, any menu command, language detection, lexer tokens, function list, Notepad++'s regex search, Compare, character-set detection, OCR, QR, spell check.

Install: `brew install --cask tanderbold/tap/notepadmac`, or the notarised .dmg from the Releases page.
